verdict.rationale: Browserbase claims it can spin up thousands of concurrent browser sessions, and its SDK lets you create and control sessions programmatically, so users can fan work out across many items in parallel. Agents can also run on a schedule or on demand. However, nothing documents a native bulk or batch operation: users must orchestrate the parallel sessions themselves in code. Missing for 10: an explicit batch/bulk API or job primitive for processing many items in one call, documentation of bulk result aggregation, and independent hands-on corroboration of large-scale concurrent runs.
